description: Create an order for a real, physical letter through the United States Postal Service. It returns a payment link; no paper is printed, postage is bought, or letter is mailed until payment completes. Use this whenever the user asks to mail, post, send by post, or physically send a letter, notice, or document to a street address. This is NOT email — use an email tool for email. US domestic addresses only. Requires a draft_id from create_draft and confirm_total_cents matching the current quote. The letter becomes irreversible once we print it.

confirm_total_cents.description: The exact total.amount_cents from the current quote, including sales tax. Say the total out loud to the user first; if it does not match the live quote this call fails and no letter is sent.

draft_id.description: The draft_id returned by create_draft or preview_draft.

idempotency_key.description: A key you generate once for this send. Retrying with the same draft_id and the same key returns the original letter instead of mailing a second one.

name: send_letter

checkout_url.description: Give this link to the user. The letter is mailed once payment completes. Null when this call replayed a send whose payment has already completed — there is then nothing to pay and nothing to relay.

mail_date_estimate.description: The calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD, New York time) this piece goes to USPS if the payment lands before that day’s 14:30 cutoff.

message.description: What to tell the user. Relay the link and the total.

quote.description: A priced letter. State total.display to the user before sending, and pass total.amount_cents as confirm_total_cents.

expires_at.description: ISO 8601 instant after which this total is re-computed from the live price card. Call preview_draft for a fresh quote before sending if it has passed.

quote_id.description: Identifier for this quote, for support and receipts.

subtotal.description: What the letter costs, before sales tax.

amount_cents.description: The amount in whole US cents.

display.description: The amount formatted for a person, with a currency symbol.

collected.description: New York sales tax on this letter. We mail from New York, so a few cents apply wherever the letter goes, and more when it is going to New York.

amount_cents.description: The amount in whole US cents.

display.description: The amount formatted for a person, with a currency symbol.

total.description: Subtotal plus sales tax. This is the number send_letter requires in confirm_total_cents.

amount_cents.description: The amount in whole US cents.

display.description: The amount formatted for a person, with a currency symbol.

version.description: The published price card this total came from.

status.description: The current letter status, including on an idempotent replay. Nothing is printed or mailed until payment completes.

title: Send a Physical Letter (USPS)
